start: Sell sheet open; total to pay ₹2,000

steps.action: Type 500 in 'Received now'
user_sees: 'Received on' appears, set to today
In the warning colour: 'Still due after this: ₹1,500'
must_not: A due that does not equal total minus received

steps.action: Choose 'Paid by', type a reference, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Membership saved. Receipt <number>.'
The member page shows ₹500 received and ₹1,500 due
The member is in Money → Dues with ₹1,500
must_not: The plan shown as fully paid

start: Sell sheet open (other kind: nothing received now)

steps.action: Leave 'Received now' blank; read its hint
user_sees: 'Leave blank if they will pay later. It will show in Dues.'
No 'Received on' box
'Still due after this: <whole total>'

steps.action: Tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Membership saved. No money taken yet.'
The whole total is in Dues

start: Sell sheet open in a gym with a UPI ID set (other kind: UPI QR at the sale)

steps.action: Show the UPI QR with Received now blank
user_sees: 'Paid by' changes to UPI
'Received now' fills with the whole total
The QR is for the whole total
must_not: Paid by left on Cash for a UPI payment
A QR amount different from Received now

steps.action: Type 500 first, then show the QR
user_sees: The QR is for ₹500 and the due line stays ₹1,500
must_not: The typed part amount replaced by the whole total

steps.action: Tap 'Confirm' only after the money has come
user_sees: A receipt for the amount in Received now
must_not: A receipt made by itself when the QR is shown
A receipt for money that never came, with no way to see it was unverified

steps.action: Type 2500 in 'Received now', tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Amount received is more than the total.'

steps.action: Type 'abc' or '1,2,3', tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'The amount received looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: The text read as some amount

steps.action: Type 0, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: Saved as nothing received: no receipt, whole total due

steps.action: Type 500, set 'Received on' to tomorrow, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'The payment date can’t be in the future.'

start: A plan sold with ₹500 of ₹2,000 received

steps.action: Later, open 'Collect payment' for the member and take the rest
user_sees: The due falls to zero and the member leaves Dues

steps.action: Cancel the ₹500 receipt with a reason
user_sees: The due goes back up by ₹500
must_not: The cancelled ₹500 still counted as received

steps.action: Cancel the plan itself while part is unpaid
user_sees: The member is no longer chased for the rest
must_not: A reminder for dues of a cancelled plan

start: After a part payment at the sale

steps.action: As owner, open Money → Collections and Dues
user_sees: ₹500 in the day’s collection under the taker’s name; ₹1,500 under Dues

steps.action: Open the member app as that member
user_sees: The plan with the amount still due, in the app’s own words
must_not: The gym’s note or the taker’s phone number
